T: The world is yours. So is the last croqueta.
D: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when Tony first walks into the Babylon Club.
S: the lunch counter Tony walked out of
Soft sweet egg rolls with mustard, ham, roast pork, Swiss and pickle, buttered and pressed in a hot pan until flat and crisp.
camp food from under the freeway, before the green card

Thick béchamel with finely chopped serrano ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight, served hot on a paper plate with lime wedges. Melt 60g butter, stir in 70g plain flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in 500ml warm milk and cook 8 minutes until very thick. Stir in 100g finely chopped serrano ham and a pinch of nutmeg. Spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight. Roll into 16 logs, dip in 2 beaten eggs and 100g fine breadcrumbs, and fry at 180C until golden.
garlic mojo, Little Havana's side order
Fry green plantain at 160C, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Garlic, lime and oil mojo over the top, flaky salt.
M: shredded beef with capsicum, rice and black beans
Simmer flank steak with bay and onion 2 hours, shred. Sofrito of onion, capsicum and garlic, add cumin, oregano, tomato, olives and the beef with some broth, simmer 20 minutes. Rice and black beans.
the nightclub where Tony makes a scene
Eye fillet seared to medium rare and rested, king prawns in garlic butter, béarnaise of tarragon reduction, yolks and clarified butter.
W: The World Is Yours guava pastelitos
read it off the blimp over Miami

Cut puff pastry into squares, top with a slice of guava paste and a spoon of cream cheese, cover, seal, egg wash, sugar. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 4 squares each. Put a 30g slice of guava paste and a teaspoon of cream cheese in the middle of 4 squares, using 120g guava and 100g cream cheese in total. Cover with the other squares, press the edges with a fork, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
K: Tony's booth at the Babylon, before it all goes sideways

Muddle mint gently with 20ml sugar syrup and 25ml lime, add 50ml white rum and crushed ice, top with soda. Dissolve 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. For each drink, gently muddle 8 mint leaves with 20ml syrup and 25ml lime juice in a tall glass, add 50ml white rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda water and stir. Makes four with 200ml rum and about 4 limes.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the bechamel overnight; crumb up to 4 hours ahead and fry to serve

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in the warm milk and cook until very thick.
Stir in the ham and nutmeg, spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight.
Roll into 16 logs, dip in egg and then breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden and serve with lime.

dishes.make_ahead: Fry once up to 2 hours ahead; second fry just before serving

steps.text: Peel the plantains and cut into 3cm chunks.
Fry at 160C for 4 minutes until soft.
Smash flat with a heavy glass and fry again at 190C until crisp.
Mix the garlic, lime juice and olive oil, spoon over and finish with flaky salt.

dishes.make_ahead: Beef up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled in its broth

steps.text: Simmer the steak with the bay leaves and half an onion in water until tender. Shred it and keep 250ml of the broth.
Fry the sliced onion, capsicums and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add the cumin, oregano, tomatoes, olives, beef and broth and simmer.
Cook the rice and warm the black beans, and serve alongside.

dishes.n: The World Is Yours guava pastelitos
dishes.make_ahead: Assemble up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; bake to serve

steps.text: Cut the pastry sheets into 8 squares in all.
Put a slice of guava paste and a teaspoon of cream cheese in the middle of 4 squares.
Cover with the other squares, press the edges with a fork, brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 200C until puffed.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
In each tall glass, gently muddle mint with some syrup and lime juice.
Add rum, fill with crushed ice, top with soda and stir.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add rum to each.
Top with cola and squeeze in a good half lime each.
Blend the rum, cream of coconut, pineapple juice and ice until smooth and frosty.
Pour into tall glasses.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the bottle at least 3 hours

steps.text: Chill the bottle in a bucket of ice.
Pour for as many guests as you have.
Brew a strong espresso for four.
Stir in sugar to taste and serve in small cups.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead; press just before serving

steps.text: Split the rolls and smear the cut sides with mustard.
Layer with ham, pork, Swiss cheese and pickle.
Brush the tops with melted butter.
Press in a heavy pan over medium heat with a second pan on top, about 3 minutes a side.

dishes.make_ahead: Béarnaise up to 2 hours ahead, keep warm

steps.text: Boil the vinegar with tarragon until almost gone. Whisk with the yolks over a pan of simmering water, then slowly beat in the melted butter until thick.
Sear the steaks in olive oil in a hot pan to your liking and rest 5 minutes.
Cook the prawns in garlic butter for 2 minutes a side.
Serve the steaks topped with prawns and the béarnaise.

s.note: Thick béchamel with finely chopped serrano ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight, served hot on a paper plate with lime wedges.
s.how: Melt 60g butter, stir in 70g plain flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in 500ml warm milk and cook 8 minutes until very thick. Stir in 100g finely chopped serrano ham and a pinch of nutmeg. Spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight. Roll into 16 logs, dip in 2 beaten eggs and 100g fine breadcrumbs, and fry at 180C until golden.

s.note: Twice-fried smashed green plantain under garlic lime mojo.
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains, cut into 3cm chunks and fry at 160C for 4 minutes until soft. Smash flat with a heavy glass and fry again at 190C until crisp. Mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes and 60ml olive oil, spoon over and finish with flaky salt.

m.note: Shredded flank steak in tomato sofrito with olives, rice and black beans.
m.how: Simmer 1kg flank steak with 2 bay leaves and half an onion in water for 2 hours until tender, then shred, keeping 250ml broth. Fry 1 sliced onion, 2 sliced capsicums and 3 garlic cloves until soft, add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, 400g crushed tomatoes, 80g green olives, the beef and broth and simmer 20 minutes. Serve with 300g rice and 2 tins black beans.
